# README image fixture

`cat.jpg` is the unmodified original of **European tabby cat looking away**,
by **Gugalcrom123**, photographed 31 December 2022 and uploaded 14 May 2023.

- Source and author/license declaration: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:European_tabby_cat_looking_away.jpg
- Original bytes: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/43/European_tabby_cat_looking_away.jpg
- License: [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
- Length: 1,652,492 bytes; dimensions: 3024 × 4032.
- SHA256: `7f6a70ce301d8c2260fd81c440bc135262f989d9b4191eda5b4f9eb8b1f1dc8e`.

The README first-screen test verifies the length and SHA256 before copying
these bytes into its subprocess directory. The original photo, pretrained ViT,
and label/probability assertions remain the same. Ordinary tests never download
this image; an intentional replacement must review those assertions and this
provenance together.
